description: K9 model manifest. Read by scripts/kobeai-models.mjs and by GET /v1/admin/models. Every entry lists exactly one downloadable artifact — a role in the K9 cascade, the framework runtime that consumes it, a URL, its SHA-256, its on-disk size in MB, and a licence flag the operator MUST honour before shipping.
docs: See docs/K9_ARCHITECTURE.md for how each model fits the cascade.

yolo-master-v26.08.purpose: Always-on object detection on every camera feed — people, faces, bags, doors, raised hands.
yolo-master-v26.08.license_note: Tencent YOLO-Master v26.08 — confirm current release terms before shipping.

bytetrack.purpose: Associates even low-confidence detection boxes across frames so track IDs survive brief occlusions.
bytetrack.note: Pure algorithm; installed via pip / source, not a downloadable weights file.

osnet-ain-x1_0.purpose: Re-identify a person across cameras when the face isn't visible.

scrfd-10g-bnkps.purpose: Fast face detection inside person boxes; upstream of ArcFace.

arcface-r100-glint360k.purpose: Face embedding — turns a face crop into the student-identity vector K9 matches against.
arcface-r100-glint360k.license_note: InsightFace pretrained recognition weights are research/non-commercial by default. Ship either an appropriately-licensed ArcFace-compatible embedding or an in-house trained one — do NOT silently ship the research weights.

youtu-vl-4b.purpose: Async scene reasoning: counting, OCR, VQA, grounding — never in the sub-second alert loop, consumed via /v1/vision/analyze queue.
youtu-vl-4b.license_note: Tencent Youtu-VL — confirm current release terms before shipping.

locate-anything-3b.purpose: Optional K9-Pro model for grounding queries like 'find the student with the blue backpack'.
locate-anything-3b.note: K9 v1 ships without this — add only if Youtu-VL can't answer a class of grounding queries the school needs.

whisper-large-v3-turbo.purpose: Classroom speech → text. 4-layer decoder version of large-v3 for realtime chunked streaming.

titanet-large.purpose: Speaker verification / diarisation — which enrolled student is speaking.
titanet-large.license_note: Pretrained on English. For Tanzanian classrooms mixing English + Kiswahili, fine-tune on school-approved enrolment recordings before relying on it for automatic attribution — see docs/K9_ARCHITECTURE.md.

qwen3-4b.purpose: The K9 assistant/reasoning layer. Sees structured events + text, never raw video. Handles timetable logic, alerts, teacher conversation.
